answer: Voting weight stays capped by stake that has physically aged in escrow, so splitting one wallet into a thousand sybils gains nothing. Condition one: each identity anchors to a fresh beacon drawn from the epoch nebula seed, so pre-minted IDs cannot anticipate the shuffle. Condition two: stake converts to timber only after sitting locked across two beacon rotations; early split clones carry thin timber and lose quorum ties. Mass identity becomes cheap to create, expensive to mature.
